scientific_integrity: An analytic proof is supplied. Finite numerical checks supplement, but cannot establish, the all-time and all-BV claims. Previously known Dobrushin reduction and heat-kernel radial monotonicity are acknowledged explicitly.

title: Sharp circular heat variation contraction and its exponentially flat onset
